description: The Feb 12 Lilongwe Community Midwifery Assistants march is supported by one opened Nyasa Times article. It reports over 500 participants and an employment demand but gives no exact upper bound, formal organizer, physical end, or state response. No independent body corroboration was opened.
required_followup: Seek an independent contemporary account or primary record for the event date, attendance, organizer, end and response. Keep unreported variables unknown; do not count the broader pool of unemployed assistants as attendance.

description: Nation Online reports a Chiwoko Primary School street protest against the teachers’ strike but gives no action date or headcount. Its article is dated Feb 23; this alone does not date the action. It does not establish a government-directed demand by the Chiwoko group.
required_followup: Find a dated account or local record giving the action date, simultaneous turnout, participants’ own demand, organizer, end and state response. Reassess month ownership, the 50-person threshold and state target.

description: The saved prior-unit Nyasa Times body summary reports police dispersing a teachers’ meeting in Lilongwe that was preparing demonstrations over government Covid-risk allowances. The current unit reused only that saved summary; it gives no exact meeting date, venue or turnout and does not settle whether the meeting itself was a qualifying public protest.
required_followup: If an approved existing source record provides a fuller saved reading, review it without repeating a request. Otherwise seek a permitted independent contemporary account for exact meeting date, public character, attendance, demand, organizer and any response. Keep prior-unit-only scope explicit.

description: Multiple search-only reports concern the nationwide public-school teachers’ strike over Covid-risk allowances; the opened Feb 23 Nation article confirms talks collapsed Feb 22, continued work stoppage and disruption across three regions. It provides no strike attendance and does not establish the strike onset. Work absence or a work stoppage alone does not establish a qualifying public gathering. A physical VOA body read occurred without a valid saved manual gate and is quarantined as S004; none of its content is used.
required_followup: Separate any street demonstrations, sit-ins, preparatory meetings and workplace strike activity. Establish exact onset, place, crowd size, state-policy target, episode boundaries and end from permitted contemporary accounts. Do not use S004 body content.

description: Face of Malawi search headers identify a possible learner street action in Dowa. The body was not requested: two preflight checks found concurrent changes to other units’ sources files and a third attempt stopped before request because its saved manual note was not verified. All three exact-URL receipts and no-request records are preserved; publication date, date of action and turnout remain unknown.
required_followup: Retain as a search-only lead. If it is revisited, start a fresh individually gated request chain with a fresh receipt, saved and read-back manual note, and immediate full-input check; otherwise preserve the unknowns.

description: A search-only Malawi24 item announces conditional student demonstrations over school closure. No reviewed evidence establishes that the planned action occurred; the search lead is not coded as an executed event.
required_followup: Find a permitted dated follow-up confirming execution or cancellation and its attendance, demand, site and response. Do not treat the announced date as an event onset without execution evidence.

description: Search-only headlines describe riots or disturbances in Neno and Lilongwe and a later security response. No body was opened in this unit to identify the actors, trigger, state-policy demand, attendance or whether the incidents were vigilante/crowd violence rather than anti-state protest.
required_followup: Use a permitted contemporary account to determine whether any distinct public gathering made a demand of the Malawian state and whether at least 50 people took part; distinguish any criminal or intercommunal violence from protest.

description: Search-only coverage concerns the fatal police shooting of fishermen on Lake Chilwa and related resident anger. Headlines do not establish a protest gathering, participants, a government-policy demand or an event-specific response. Later court proceedings are not evidence that a protest occurred.
required_followup: If pursuing this lead, separate the shooting, any immediate crowd reaction, and later legal events. Establish a qualifying anti-state public gathering, date, attendance and demand from contemporaneous evidence before coding.

description: The January Malawi dossier has candidates for Mapanga quarantine, CDEDI small-business action, Zomba and Lilongwe sex-worker actions, minibus operators’ protest and an AHL demonstration announcement. The February search corpus yielded no positively linked continuation record that can be coded here. This non-discovery does not establish that the January episodes ended, nor does the unverified AHL announcement establish an event.
required_followup: Use later month dossiers or additional records to test episode closure and continuation. Do not duplicate a January onset in February or infer cessation from silence.

description: Twenty-six recorded open-web search actions yielded 518 ordered result headers, spanning four weekly date windows and broader national, sector, episode, official, regional and Chichewa keyword queries. This method cannot reproduce LexisNexis, search indexing is noisy, and Chichewa coverage was not reviewed by a fluent speaker. The 25 source cards are leads/evidence, not proof of exhaustive coverage.
required_followup: For a stronger first-pass review, consult an accessible systematic news archive and fluent Chichewa reviewer, then check local/regional media and official or labor sources. Do not infer no protest from non-discovery.

description: One physical body read occurred for VOA source S004 on 2026-10-10 without a valid pre-request saved manual publisher/origin review note. The result is quarantined and excluded from all scientific claims; its full original failure trace is preserved in the incident record. S008 has three fresh checks but no body requests. The S002 exact URL was reused only through its saved January source summary.
required_followup: No retroactive manual note, waiver or second S004 request. Keep S004 search_only with invalid_physical_body_read disclosed; retain S008 as search_only with all three no-request outcomes; count valid/current and invalid physical reads separately.
